questions.basis: The Folger Shakespeare Library's Shakespeare Documented record of the Huntington Library's 1603 first quarto title page identifies William Shakespeare as creator and names him in the printed title; the Folger Hamlet overview also identifies the play as Shakespeare's.

The British Library catalogue identifies its Jane Eyre autograph fair copy as Charlotte Brontë's and records 1847 publication under Currer Bell; the Brontë Parsonage Museum identifies the first edition and the sisters' distinct Bell pseudonyms.
